generationPhases.name: choose-family
generationPhases.rule: Select a concrete recipe family or governed template; selection creates no world/culture facts.

generationPhases.name: resolve-slots
generationPhases.rule: Every ingredient/preparation slot must resolve to a stable canonical ICF definition ref before executable use.

generationPhases.name: validate-quantity-unit
generationPhases.rule: Each retained input uses an authored quantity and an allowed canonical unit; no source-generic unit conversion is inferred.

generationPhases.name: validate-role-and-substitution
generationPhases.rule: Role/selector/substitution compatibility must be explicitly governed; names, folklore, affinities, or co-occurrence do not authorize substitution.

generationPhases.name: bind-outcome-authority
generationPhases.rule: Ordinary/magical food outcomes reference ICF-12; alchemical outcomes/formulas reference ICF-11; ICF-14 does not create a second effect engine.

generationPhases.name: bind-context
generationPhases.rule: Optional setting/culture/region scope must point to separately authored governed context; generic regional templates never create canon.

generationPhases.name: runtime-prerequisite-check
generationPhases.rule: At execution, owning domains revalidate tools/facilities/knowledge/availability/resources and applicable ICF-11/12 checks.

generationPhases.name: owner-domain-commit
generationPhases.rule: Inputs/outputs become live changes only through D17/Asset/inventory or the relevant owning result path with provenance/idempotency.

templateResolution.exactIngredientLockRule: permitted only when source-authored or intentionally first-party-authored as an exact recipe; broad examples never auto-lock
templateResolution.propertyThresholdRule: only explicitly governed properties/effects qualify; ICF-08 tendencies alone do not
